PushinWeight / design reference / 2026-08-29

Country flags at feed weight.

All 215 exact 16×9 country and area flags, converted to reusable SVG symbols. Compare source color against the approved presentation-only reductions before any homepage integration.

Review boundary 215 flags · Recommended approved

Reference artifact for the homepage feed integration. Runtime instances use the Recommended presentation while source fills stay exact.

Inventory215 symbols
Source grid16 × 9 pixels
Feed peers12 px role badge
Country codes214 ISO · XK source code

Color approach

Keep source fills fixed. Reduce only the displayed SVG instance with CSS. The recommended starting point uses 72% saturation, 90% brightness, and 90% opacity so flags remain identifiable without competing with role or sentiment accents.

Feed-context comparison

Each treatment shows the same source symbol at 8× inspection scale, native 16×9, and 14 px wide at its natural 16:9 height. The official-account badge preserves the current 14×12 slot and 12×12 icon geometry.
